title: Narrow each agent profile declared sources, then lower max_tokens again (DEC-184 (5) option B)
description: Follow-up to the 0.14.0 release prep (QCLI-499), not part of it. lore 0.14.0 added error-tier agent-profile-pin-capacity checks; QCLI-499 cleared them by raising max_tokens on the four .lore/agents profiles to lore printed needs (documentation 28330, implementation 31451, review 32351, verification 46204), opum-doc ruling DEC-184 (5) option A. This task is option B: one design pass per role, verification first, narrowing each profile declared sources to what a small budget holds. The proposed source list for each role goes to opum-doc via the team leader BEFORE it lands; only then are max_tokens lowered again. Budgets are not changed ahead of that answer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: For each of the four roles, the proposed narrowed source list has been sent to opum-doc via the leader and its answer recorded on this task before any source list or budget changes
Each role profile declares only the sources opum-doc approved, its max_tokens is lowered to what lore reports that set needs, and lore check exits 0 with 0 over-capacity profiles
Verification is done first, and each role lands as its own reviewable change
